seoTitle: How to See Speaker Notes in a Canva Presentation
metaDescription: Use Canva's Presenter View to read your speech cues and notes privately while your audience only sees the main presentation slides.
intro: Delivering a confident presentation is easier when you have your speaking notes visible without your audience seeing them. Canva's Presenter View lets you split your screen so notes and upcoming slides show privately on your device while the audience only sees the main deck. Here's how to set it up.

steps.heading: Open the notes panel
steps.body: On your presentation canvas, locate the Notes button on the bottom editor bar.

steps.heading: Write your speaker notes
steps.body: Type and format your script or key talking points under each relevant slide.

steps.heading: Activate Presenter Mode
steps.body: Open the presentation menu and select the Presenter View option to enable the private notes display.

steps.heading: Launch the split-screen view
steps.body: Start the Presenter View dashboard, which shows your notes and upcoming slides on one screen while the audience sees only the main slide.

steps.heading: Adjust text size for readability
steps.body: Increase the font size in the notes container if needed so your cues are easy to read on stage.

steps.heading: Close Presenter View when finished
steps.body: Exit Presenter View without interrupting the slideshow once your presentation wraps up.

faq.question: Will my audience see the notes on the shared screen?
faq.answer: No, Presenter View is designed to keep your notes visible only on your own device while sharing just the slides to your audience.

faq.question: Can I adjust the font size of my notes during a presentation?
faq.answer: Yes, you can resize the notes text for better on-stage visibility before or during your presentation.

faq.question: Is there a shortcut to toggle Presenter View on and off?
faq.answer: Yes, keyboard shortcuts are available to quickly toggle your presenter notes dashboard without navigating through menus.

faq.question: Do I need Canva Pro to use Presenter View?
faq.answer: Presenter View and speaker notes are core presentation features intended for use across standard Canva presentation projects.
